source: Wisconsin Department of Health Services, Division of Public Health, Office of Health Informatics: WISH (Wisconsin Interactive Statistics on Health), Mortality Module, Broad causes by county of residence by year of death (query results pages saved verbatim under sources/wi_wish)
note: WISH states: an 'X' indicates a value less than 5 (but more than zero) and has been suppressed to protect confidentiality; a period (.) means zero cases; rows or columns that are all zero are not displayed. So counts of 5 and above are published, and only 1-4 is hidden. The X cells are NOT in `data`; they are listed in `masked` (cause -> year -> counties) so the build can show them as '1-4' instead of '1-9' where CDC hides the cell. Counties missing from a cause page have zero deaths in every year 1999-2024 (all-zero rows are not displayed) and are not listed in `data`. Years 1999-2024. 'accidents' has no MortalGIS measure yet; 'all' maps to all_deaths. Cause labels follow WISH 'Broad causes'.
